facts.text: The image is a multi-panel character reference sheet arranged in three rows, with a wide cinematic scene at the top, three full-body turnaround views in the middle, and four close-up detail crops at the bottom.
The top panel, labeled HERO, shows a figure standing on a wet urban walkway or bridge at night in the rain, with metal railings on both sides and blurred city lights in the background.
The middle row shows the same figure in three standing views against a dark studio backdrop, labeled FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, and BACK.
The bottom row contains four detail crops labeled FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, and BOOTS.
The person has short dark hair with shaved sides and a small topknot or bun at the back, and a visible scar above one eyebrow.
The person wears a black collared tactical jacket with a strap and metal buckle detail, a dark shirt, black cargo trousers, and black lace-up combat boots.

The hero panel uses low-key lighting with cool blue-gray rain and pavement tones contrasted by warm amber lights; the turnaround and detail panels use soft, controlled lighting against a dark background.
Legible on-screen text reads: HERO, FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, BACK, FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, BOOTS.
